summary.text: Jessica Arriaga is the Republican nominee, a healthcare professional from North Philadelphia. Her campaign says she has worked in operating rooms for more than 20 years and describes herself as a mother. She advanced unopposed from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary and is running on a message of results-focused leadership for Philadelphia families.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, she was born and raised in North Philadelphia and is a mother.
Has worked in operating rooms as a healthcare professional for more than 20 years, and says she has also helped families in her community find healthcare, resources and opportunity.
Describes herself as "not a career politician" and says she is not backed by political insiders.
Advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for Pennsylvania's 2nd District with 100% of 6,328 votes, with no other candidate on the ballot.
